requirement: Return a page of antibiotic groups ordered by creation time descending: apply the optional parent-ID filter, project the parent's name through the navigation, and wrap the page with pagination metadata.

preconditions.text: One root group and two subgroups are seeded one minute apart
One further root group is seeded as the newest row
The parent-ID filter matches no stored group

inputs.text: Parent-ID filter on the root group, page 1, size 10
Parent-ID filter with an unknown GUID, page 1, size 10

returns.text: Success with the requested page and its metadata
Subgroups carry the parent name; root groups keep a null parent name
An empty page with zero total items when the filter matches nothing

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the read-only query has no failure branch
